vsam.why: base/cntl/adef121.jcl DEFINE1: DATA(... KEYS(10 0) RECORDSIZE(225 225)); the engine's facts do not read KEYS / RECORDSIZE inside the DATA component, so the case states them

scenarios.name: add-with-counter
scenarios.why: LGACDB01's scenario add-with-counter through LGACUS01 (LINKed, COMMAREA passed on): GET COUNTER GENA/GENACUSTNUM: NORMAL, 1000011 (the counter is then 1000012); INSERT CUSTOMER with that number; LINK LGACVS01 writes the VSAM copy; LINK LGACDB02 adds the CUSTOMER_SECURE row; CA-CUSTOMER-NUM 1000011, '00'

scenarios.name: add-without-counter
scenarios.why: LGACDB01's scenario add-without-counter through LGACUS01 (LINKed, COMMAREA passed on): no named counter (GET COUNTER is INVREQ RESP2 201, which the program reads as not NORMAL): INSERT with DEFAULT, the identity gives 1000001 (START WITH, restarted each run), SET :H = IDENTITY_VAL_LOCAL() reads it back on the INSERT's own connection

scenarios.name: add-blank-optional-fields
scenarios.why: LGACDB01's scenario add-blank-optional-fields through LGACUS01 (LINKed, COMMAREA passed on): blank house name / number / phones / email stored as blanks (CHAR), not NULL

scenarios.name: add-long-email
scenarios.why: LGACDB01's scenario add-long-email through LGACUS01 (LINKed, COMMAREA passed on): a 100-byte email fills EMAILADDRESS CHAR(100)

scenarios.name: no-commarea
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: LGACUS01 moves ' NO COMMAREA RECEIVED' to EM-VARIABLE, WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE LINKs LGSTSQ with ERROR-MSG (TD CSMT and TS GENAERRS), IF EIBCALEN > 0 is false, then ABEND LGCA

scenarios.name: short-commarea
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 60 < WS-REQUIRED-CA-LEN 90 (18 + WS-CUSTOMER-LEN 72): CA-RETURN-CODE '98', RETURN before the LINK

notes: Generated-row sibling (#4507) of genapp-lgacus01: GenApp's add-customer front end (LGACUS01, LINKed with the 32500-byte LGCMAREA COMMAREA) LINKs LGACDB01 in the same task (which LINKs LGACVS01 and LGACDB02, and LGSTSQ on errors) over the ten CUSTOMER and ten CUSTOMER_SECURE rows of genapp-lgacdb01-generated, generated from base/cntl/db2cre.jcl (seed 4507, CUSTOMER_SECURE keyed to CUSTOMER by its foreign key), not GenApp's INSERTs. The 16 generated requests are those of genapp-lgacdb01-generated; stated: the add scenarios (with and without the GENA/GENACUSTNUM counter, blank optional fields, a 100-byte email), no-commarea (EIBCALEN 0: LGSTSQ, ABEND LGCA) and short-commarea (EIBCALEN 60: '98').
